The d1 and d4 chains stop at g_0853_d1 and g_0853_d4, because only the _v2 variants connect onward. The d3 chain stops at g_d0ff_d3 for the same reason. The base chain does reach g_fbe3 and grants r_0ca3, but r_0ca3 has no inheritance. The only related rule says r_e3ef's permissions flow to a different role, r_0ca3_v2, and in the wrong direction. So u_b44b gains no role with access to x_ce40.
